clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, Burning Blade cultists keep their rites beneath Dreadmist Peak. Red haze fills the cavern they use as a shrine to demons.

Dreadmist Den cuts into the jagged slopes of Dreadmist Peak, where Burning Blade cultists gather in a dark sanctuary. Thick crimson vapor hangs through its stone tunnels, dimming the cavern in red twilight. Away from the Horde's watch in the plains below, the cult performs demonic rites, guards its blasphemous relics, and plots to spread corruption across Kalimdor.
